metadata.description: The billing go-live matrix against a deployed stack (staging unless TAU_E2E_BASE_URL/TAU_E2E_API_URL say otherwise; tau.new is refused): fresh mail.tm accounts, the real API and Stripe hosted Checkout in test mode. BILLING_E2E_SUITE=smoke|p0|all selects rows. Writes results.json and results-matrix.md under out/test-results/billing-e2e/<runId>. Its config is not named vitest.config.ts, so affected CI never runs it: the inferred `test` target runs only the harness's own unit tests (src/**/*.test.ts, no network).
